gloss: to retire a batter; to get (a batter) out

definitions.gloss: to retire a batter; to get (a batter) out (baseball)
definitions.explanation: (of a pitcher or the fielding side) to put a batter out without allowing a hit, often by inducing a weak grounder or fly ball.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{取|と}った。
⟦{内野|ないや}→内野：09267_naiya⟧ゴロ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{取|と}る。
examples.english: To retire the batter with an infield grounder.

examples.japanese: ⟦エース→エース：28537_eesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ピッチャーゴロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{取|と}って⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}めた→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The ace retired the last batter with a grounder to the mound, closing out the game.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive; takes the retired batter as the ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ object.

A baseball term for getting a batter out. Often specifies how the out was made:
- ⟦{内野|ないや}→内野：09267_naiya⟧ゴロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{取|と}る: to retire with an infield grounder
- ⟦{凡打|ぼんだ}→凡打：30024_bonda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{取|と}る: to induce an easy out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {討|う}ち{取|と}る: to slay; to defeat (an enemy in battle) — a homophone written with a different kanji
